status: validation windows fixed; final evaluation not executed
dataset: complete train role; testA and testB excluded
final_region: strictly after validation_end, never used for method/parameter selection
request_definition: immediately after an observed click, next strictly-later event as target
candidate_availability: provided created_at_ts <= request time; not recovered real catalog ingestion time
tie_policy: exclude next-event transitions with equal timestamps and report count
denominator: all eligible proxy requests, including empty lists and unavailable targets

global_state_variants.frozen: fit item-pair/popularity statistics only before train_end; replay user histories
global_state_variants.live_trend: same request cohort; rolling 6h observed-event counts, refresh ranking every 5min; reveal timestamp batch after requests

comparison_warning: frozen and live-trend state differ explicitly; any gap is not attributable only to model architecture
limitations: no impressions or actual request timestamps
